data.name: SettingsTitle
data.comment: Title of the settings window. 'Shapeshifter' is the app's name and is never translated.

data.name: SettingsVersion
data.comment: Shown under the app name; {0} is a version number such as 7.1.0.

data.name: SettingsCopyVersion
data.comment: Link that copies the version and OS to the clipboard for bug reports.

data.name: SettingsCopied
data.comment: Replaces 'Copy version' for two seconds after it was clicked.

data.name: SettingsReportProblem
data.comment: Link that opens a new GitHub issue.

data.name: SettingsProjectPage
data.comment: Link to the project's GitHub page.

data.name: SettingsUsage
data.value: Copy as usual. To paste an older item, hold {0} and press V: keep {0} held to see the history, press V again (or ↑/↓, or 1–9) to pick an item, → to choose what to do with it, Delete to remove it and Esc to cancel. Release {0} to paste.
data.comment: How to use the app, at the top of the settings window. {0} is the modifier key name (Ctrl, or Cmd on macOS). Keep V, ↑/↓, 1–9, →, Delete and Esc as key names (you may use the local name of the Delete and Esc keys).

data.name: SettingsHistoryGroup
data.comment: Header of a group of settings about the clipboard history.

data.name: SettingsDelayTitle
data.comment: Setting title; the value is in milliseconds.

data.name: SettingsDelayDescription
data.value: How long to hold {0}+V before the history appears
data.comment: {0} is the modifier key (Ctrl or Cmd).

data.name: SettingsDelayAccessibleName
data.value: Delay before the history appears, in milliseconds
data.comment: Screen reader name of the number box.

data.name: SettingsItemsTitle
data.comment: Setting title: how many clipboard items the history keeps.

data.name: SettingsItemsDescription
data.value: Pinned items are kept in addition
data.comment: Pinned items do not count toward the limit.

data.name: SettingsRememberTitle
data.comment: Setting title (toggle).

data.name: SettingsRememberDescription
data.value: Keeps the history on this computer's disk, not just pinned items
data.comment: Description of the toggle above.

data.name: SettingsBehaviourGroup
data.comment: Header of a group of general settings.

data.name: SettingsNotificationsTitle
data.comment: Setting title (toggle).

data.name: SettingsNotificationsDescription
data.value: Show a notification each time something is copied
data.comment: Description of the toggle above.

data.name: SettingsStartAtLoginTitle
data.comment: Setting title (toggle): start the app when the user signs in to the computer.

data.name: SettingsStartAtLoginDescription
data.value: Shapeshifter waits in the background after you sign in
data.comment: Description of the toggle above.

data.name: SettingsUpdatesTitle
data.comment: Setting title (toggle).

data.name: SettingsClearHistory
data.comment: Button that removes all unpinned clipboard items. Also in the tray menu.

data.name: SettingsCheckForUpdates
data.comment: Button.

data.name: SettingsOpenLogFolder
data.comment: Button that opens the folder with the log files. Also in the tray menu.

data.name: PickerTitleWindows
data.comment: Title of the picker popup in the Windows look.

data.name: PickerTitleMacOS
data.comment: Title of the picker popup in the macOS look.

data.name: PickerItemCountOne
data.comment: Number of items in the history, in a small badge in the picker header. Exactly one item.

data.name: PickerItemCountOther
data.comment: Number of items in the history, in a small badge; {0} is 0 or 2 and more. Use a form that reads correctly for any number (e.g. 'Items: {0}') if the language has several plural forms.

data.name: PickerReleaseHint
data.comment: Picker header hint; {0} is the modifier key (Ctrl or ⌘).

data.name: PickerNothingCopied
data.comment: Shown in the empty picker.

data.name: PickerEmptyHint
data.value:
Copy as usual, and Shapeshifter keeps everything you copy.
To paste something you copied earlier, hold {0} and press V. Keep holding {0} to see the history, press V or the arrow keys to choose, and release {0} to paste.
data.comment: Shown in the empty picker. {0} is the modifier key (Ctrl or Cmd). Keep the \n\n paragraph break.

data.name: PickerActions
data.comment: Header above the list of actions for the selected item; also a footer hint for the ←→ keys.

data.name: PickerActionsForText
data.comment: Header above the actions of a text item.

data.name: PickerActionsForImage
data.comment: Header above the actions of an image item.

data.name: PickerActionsForFile
data.comment: Header above the actions of one copied file.

data.name: PickerActionsForFiles
data.comment: Header above the actions of several copied files.

data.name: PickerDefault
data.comment: Small badge next to the action that runs when the key is released. Keep it short.

data.name: PickerHintRelease
data.comment: Footer hint next to the modifier key cap. Keep it short.

data.name: PickerHintMove
data.comment: Footer hint next to the V and ↑↓ key caps: move the selection. One short word.

data.name: PickerHintJump
data.comment: Footer hint next to the 1–9 key cap: jump to that item. One short word.

data.name: PickerHintRemove
data.comment: Footer hint next to the Delete key cap: remove the item. One short word.

data.name: PickerHintCancel
data.comment: Footer hint next to the Esc key cap. One short word.

data.name: KeyControl
data.comment: Label of the Control key as printed on keyboards in this language (German: Strg).

data.name: KeyDelete
data.comment: Label of the Delete key as printed on keyboards in this language (German: Entf). Very short.

data.name: KeyEscape
data.comment: Label of the Escape key as printed on keyboards. Usually stays Esc.

data.name: ItemEmpty
data.comment: Title of a text item that only contains whitespace.

data.name: ItemImage
data.comment: A copied image.

data.name: ItemImageWithSize
data.comment: A copied image; {0} is the width and {1} the height in pixels.

data.name: ItemFilesWithNames
data.comment: Several copied files; {0} is the count (2 or more), {1} a comma-separated list of file names.

data.name: ItemFileCount
data.comment: Several copied files; {0} is the count (2 or more).

data.name: ItemFormattedText
data.comment: Text copied with formatting (HTML or RTF).

data.name: ItemOtherData
data.comment: Clipboard content of an unknown kind.

data.name: ItemCharacterCount
data.comment: Length of a one-line text; {0} is any number.

data.name: ItemLineCount
data.comment: Number of lines of a text; {0} is 2 or more.

data.name: ToastCopiedOne
data.comment: Notification shown after copying, when the history holds exactly one item.

data.name: ToastCopiedOther
data.comment: Notification shown after copying; {0} is 2 or more.

data.name: TraySettings
data.comment: Tray menu item.

data.name: TrayCheckForUpdates
data.comment: Tray menu item.

data.name: TrayReportProblem
data.comment: Tray menu item.

data.name: TrayAbout
data.comment: Tray menu item; {0} is the version number.

data.name: TrayQuit
data.comment: Tray menu item that exits the app.

data.name: StartupErrorTitle
data.comment: Title of the error window shown when the app fails to start.

data.name: StartupErrorDetails
data.comment: {0} is the path of the log folder.

data.name: StartupErrorQuit
data.comment: Button that closes the error window and the app.

data.name: ActionPaste
data.comment: Action title.

data.name: ActionPasteDescription
data.comment: Action description.

data.name: ActionPasteAsPlainText
data.comment: Action title.

data.name: ActionPasteAsPlainTextDescription
data.value: Pastes clipboard contents as plain text with no formatting.
data.comment: Action description.

data.name: ActionPasteAsFile
data.comment: Action title: save the text to a .txt file and paste the file.

data.name: ActionPasteAsFileDescription
data.value: Saves this text to a .txt file and pastes the file.
data.comment: Action description.

data.name: ActionCopyAsZip
data.comment: Action title: zip the copied files.

data.name: ActionCopyAsZipDescription
data.value: Copy these files to the clipboard as a compressed (.zip) folder.
data.comment: Action description.

data.name: ActionCopyImageFromLink
data.comment: Action title: download the image a copied link points to.

data.name: ActionCopyImageFromLinkDescription
data.value: Downloads the linked image and copies the image itself to the clipboard.
data.comment: Action description.

data.name: ActionOpenLink
data.comment: Action title, when the text contains exactly one link.

data.name: ActionOpenLinks
data.comment: Action title, when the text contains several links.

data.name: ActionOpenLinkDescription
data.value: Opens the link in your browser.
data.comment: Action description, one link.

data.name: ActionOpenLinksDescription
data.value: Opens the links in your browser (at most {0}).
data.comment: Action description, several links; {0} is 10.

data.name: ActionPin
data.comment: Action title: keep the item at the top and save it to disk.

data.name: ActionPinDescription
data.value: Pins this item so that it always stays at the top, and saves it to your computer so that it is there the next time you open Shapeshifter.
data.comment: Action description.

data.name: ActionUnpin
data.comment: Action title: undo pinning.

data.name: ActionUnpinDescription
data.value: Unpins this item so that it moves down as you copy, and is no longer saved to your computer.
data.comment: Action description.

data.name: TimeJustNow
data.comment: When an item was copied: less than a minute ago.

data.name: TimeMinutesAgo
data.comment: When an item was copied; {0} is 1 to 59. Keep it short; an abbreviation is fine.

data.name: TimeHoursAgo
data.comment: When an item was copied; {0} is 1 to 23. Keep it short; an abbreviation is fine.

data.name: TimeYesterday
data.comment: When an item was copied.

data.name: TimeDaysAgo
data.comment: When an item was copied; {0} is 2 to 6.

data.name: UpdateOff
data.comment: Status line under the 'Automatic updates' setting.

data.name: UpdateUnsupported
data.comment: Status line.

data.name: UpdateChecking
data.comment: Status line.

data.name: UpdateUpToDate
data.comment: Status line; {0} is a time of day such as 14:05.

data.name: UpdateDownloading
data.comment: Status line; {0} is a version number.

data.name: UpdateReadyToRestart
data.value: Version {0} is installed and starts the next time {1} does
data.comment: Status line; {0} is a version number, {1} is the app name (Shapeshifter).

data.name: UpdateFailed
data.comment: Status line; {0} is an error message (may be in English).

data.name: UpdateAutomatic
data.comment: Status line.

data.name: UpdateTurnedOff
data.comment: Status line; {0} is the name of an environment variable.

data.name: UpdateReleaseBuildsOnly
data.comment: Status line, for developer builds.

data.name: UpdateCannotWrite
data.value: {0} cannot write to {1}; update it the way it was installed
data.comment: Status line; {0} is the app name, {1} a folder path.

data.name: PlatformNeedsX11
data.value: Shapeshifter needs an X11 display (DISPLAY is not set). On Wayland, make sure XWayland is available.
data.comment: Linux error. Keep X11, DISPLAY, Wayland and XWayland as they are.

data.name: PlatformWayland
data.value: This is a Wayland session. Wayland does not let applications observe or synthesize global keystrokes, so the paste gesture only works while an X11 (XWayland) application is focused. Log in to an X11 session for full support.
data.comment: Linux warning shown in the settings window.

data.name: PlatformAccessibility
data.value: Shapeshifter needs Accessibility access to see and send the Cmd+V keystroke. Allow it in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility and restart Shapeshifter.
data.comment: macOS warning. Use the names macOS itself uses in this language for System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility.

data.name: PlatformNotSupported
data.comment: {0} is the name of an operating system.

data.name: ToggleOn
data.comment: Label beside a switch that is on (settings window). One short word, as in the OS settings.

data.name: ToggleOff
data.comment: Label beside a switch that is off (settings window). One short word, as in the OS settings.

data.name: ActionPasteAsImageFileDescription
data.value: Saves this image to a .{0} file and pastes the file.
data.comment: Action description for 'Paste as file' on an image; {0} is a file extension such as png or jpg.

data.name: ActionUploadImage
data.comment: Action title: upload the copied image to an image host and paste a link to it.

data.name: ActionUploadImageDescription
data.value: Uploads this image to {0} and pastes a public link to it.
data.comment: Action description; {0} is the name of the image host (Catbox).

data.name: SettingsTipsTitle
data.comment: Setting title (toggle): show coaching tips.

data.name: SettingsTipsDescription
data.value: Suggest when the history could have saved you a copy
data.comment: Description of the Tips toggle: Shapeshifter points out when the user copied something that the clipboard history already had.

data.name: TipAlreadyInHistoryTitle
data.comment: Title of a tip notification shown when the user copies something that is already in the history.

data.name: TipAlreadyInHistoryMessage
data.value: No need to copy it again: hold {0}+V to pick it from your history.
data.comment: Tip notification text; {0} is the modifier key (Ctrl or Cmd).

data.name: TipDidYouKnowTitle
data.comment: Title of a tip notification.

data.name: TipCopyBackAndForthMessage
data.value: You can copy several things from {0} first, then hold {1}+V in {2} to pick each one from your history.
data.comment: Tip shown when the user switches back and forth between two apps to copy and paste; {0} and {2} are application names, {1} is the modifier key (Ctrl or Cmd).

data.name: DialogCancel
data.comment: Button that closes a dialog without doing anything.

data.name: PickerEmptyHintHoldOpen
data.value: Press Space to keep the history open without holding the key, then Enter to paste.
data.comment: Appended directly after PickerEmptyHint (the empty-picker explanation). Starts with a space because it follows a sentence: keep a leading space if your language separates sentences with a space, and drop it if not (Chinese, Japanese, Thai). Keep Space and Enter as key names (you may use the local key names).

data.name: SettingsUsageHoldOpen
data.value: To look through the history without holding {0}, press Space: it stays open until you press Enter to paste or Esc.
data.comment: Appended directly after SettingsUsage. Starts with a space because it follows a sentence: keep a leading space if your language separates sentences with a space, and drop it if not (Chinese, Japanese, Thai). {0} is the modifier key (Ctrl or Cmd).

data.name: PickerReleaseHintHeldOpen
data.comment: Picker header hint while the picker is kept open with Space.

data.name: PickerHintClose
data.comment: Footer hint next to the Esc key cap while the picker is kept open. One short word.

data.name: PickerHintPaste
data.comment: Footer hint next to the Enter key cap. One short word.

data.name: PickerHintKeepOpen
data.comment: Footer hint next to the Space key cap: keep the picker open without holding the modifier key. Short.

data.name: KeyEnter
data.comment: Label of the Enter key as printed on keyboards in this language (German: Eingabe is rare; Enter or ↵ is fine). Very short.

data.name: KeySpace
data.comment: Label of the Space bar on a key cap in this language (German: Leertaste). Short.

data.name: PickerHintSearch
data.comment: Footer hint next to the S key cap: S starts searching the history. Short.

data.name: PickerSearchPlaceholder
data.comment: Placeholder in the empty search box of the picker.

data.name: PickerSearchNoMatches
data.comment: Title shown when a search of the clipboard history finds nothing. Short.

data.name: PickerSearchNoMatchesText
data.comment: Shown under the title when a search finds nothing. {0} is what the user typed; keep the quotation marks of your language around it.

data.name: UpdatePullRequestBuild
data.value: Pull request builds do not update themselves
data.comment: Status line in Settings, for builds of a pull request (made for testing a change; they never update).

data.name: SettingsShortcutTitle
data.comment: Setting title, Windows and macOS: which keys open the history (Ctrl+V or Win+V on Windows, Cmd+V or Ctrl+V on macOS).

data.name: SettingsShortcutDescription
data.value: Win+V replaces the Windows clipboard history, so Ctrl+V pastes as usual
data.comment: Windows: explains the Win+V choice of the shortcut setting. Use the local name of the Ctrl key (German: Strg).

data.name: SettingsShortcutDescriptionMac
data.value: Ctrl+V leaves Cmd+V free to paste as usual
data.comment: macOS: explains the Ctrl+V choice of the shortcut setting. Keep Cmd; use the local name of the Ctrl key (German: Strg).
